state.task: You are on the support-desk app in this directory. Add a refund desk agent. Create `src/agents.ts` exporting `refundAgent`, an agent that handles refund requests such as "I want a refund for order A-1001, it arrived broken." It looks the order up with the existing `lookupOrder` tool from `src/tools.ts`, then pauses for a human to approve the refund of the order total as the lookup returns it (the agent never asks the customer for an amount), and only if approved issues it with a tool named `issueRefund` built on `createRefund` from `src/db.ts`. The approval step is named `approveRefund`; it takes `{ orderId: string, amount: number, reason: string }` and the human answers it with `{ approved: boolean, note?: string }`. When the refund is declined, nothing is refunded and the agent ends with a short reply to the customer. Export `refundAgent` from `src/index.ts`. Callers hold a conversation with it: `refundAgent.chat()` starts one and `send(message)` sends a message; when a turn pauses for approval, the caller answers the pending `approveRefund` request and resumes the same conversation. Keep the existing flows and their exports. Don't change `package.json` or add dependencies.
